verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Sentry has an official CLI documented at docs.sentry.io/cli, so the product itself provides the capability. Nothing in the pack describes what the CLI does or how it fits agent or AI-native workflows. missing for 10: documented CLI commands and capabilities, evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI usage (e.g. machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
